**正文**

# Product Operations Manager

P-1587

As a Product Operations Manager, you will own and run the operational backbone of a fast-growing part of our business, and build the automation that lets it scale. You sit between our field, product, engineering, and go-to-market teams, and you turn fast-moving, high-growth work into operations that are reliable and repeatable.

This role is equal parts operator and builder. You will own complex operational processes end to end and, at the same time, design and build the tools, workflows, and automations that remove manual work so a lean team can do far more. You are comfortable owning ambiguous, high-stakes operations. You bring operational rigor, you build, and you make things scale.

Responsibilities

Own an operational domain end to end: design the process, run it, set the SLAs and quality bar, and keep it reliable as volume grows.

Build automations, tools, and workflows (scripting, low-code, RPA, and AI or agent tooling) that eliminate manual work and let the team scale without adding headcount.

Turn ambiguous, manual, or ad-hoc work into standardized, well-documented, repeatable processes.

Analyze data from multiple sources to surface issues, set priorities, and inform decisions.

Build the reporting and dashboards that give leadership real-time visibility into operational health.

Partner across product, engineering, sales, marketing, and field teams to align on priorities and remove operational friction.

Deliver in ambiguous, fast-moving conditions with incomplete data, and bring the operational rigor that makes the work repeatable.

Champion Databricks principles: be customer obsessed, be data-driven, teamwork makes the dream work, and own it.

Competencies / Requirements

5+ years in product operations, business operations, revenue or GTM operations, or a business/data analyst role with clear operational ownership.

A builder. You have shipped automations, tools, or workflows with real operational impact, using some mix of Python, low-code or RPA (for example Power Automate or KNIME), Apps Script, workflow platforms, or AI, LLM, and agent tooling. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do need to build, and to pick up new tools like Claude Code quickly.

Strong operational ownership. You have run a process or system end to end (approvals, onboarding, quality controls, or an operating cadence), not only analyzed it.

Working SQL, plus hands-on experience building dashboards and reporting (Power BI, Tableau, or similar).

Excellent communication. Comfortable working with executives and distilling complex work into clear messaging.

Enterprise software background. SaaS and B2B experience required.

Comfortable moving fast while holding a high bar for detail and quality.

Entrepreneurial, "can do" attitude.

# AI Engineer – Forward Deployed Engineering (AI FDE), U.S. Public Sector (Federal Focus)

PLEASE NOTE: 
Due to federal contract requirements and client site access obligations, U.S. citizenship and eligibility for a U.S. government secret clearance are required to access classified information. The position is based in the Washington, D.C., Maryland, or Virginia metropolitan area and includes periodic on‑site work and client collaboration. Candidates with an active Secret or higher clearance are strongly encouraged to apply.

The AI Forward Deployed Engineering (AI FDE) team is a highly specialized customer-facing AI team at Databricks. We deliver professional services engagements to help our customers build and productionize first-of-its-kind AI applications. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations, as well as support internal subject matter expert (SME) teams. We view our team as an ensemble: we look for individuals with strong, unique specializations to improve the overall strength of the team. This team is the right fit for you if you love working with customers, teammates, and fueling your curiosity for the latest trends in GenAI, LLMOps, and ML more broadly. This role can be remote.

The impact you will have:

Develop cutting-edge GenAI solutions, incorporating the latest techniques from Databricks AI research to solve customer problems

Own production rollouts of consumer and internally facing GenAI applications

Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers across a variety of domains

Present at conferences such as Data + AI Summit, recognized as a thought leader internally and externally

Collaborate cross-functionally with the product and engineering teams to influence priorities and shape the product roadmap 

What we look for:

Experience building GenAI applications, including RAG, multi-agent systems, Text2SQL, fine-tuning, etc., with tools such as HuggingFace, LangChain, and DSPy

Expertise in deploying production-grade GenAI applications, including evaluation and optimizations 

Extensive years of hands-on industry data science experience, leveraging common machine learning and data science tools, i.e. pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, etc.

Experience building production-grade machine learning deployments on AWS, Azure, or GCP

Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, etc.) or equivalent practical experience

Experience communicating and/or teaching technical concepts to non-technical and technical audiences alike

Passion for collaboration, life-long learning, and driving business value through AI

[Preferred] Experience using the Databricks Intelligence Platform and Apache Spark™ to process large-scale distributed datasets

Willing to travel once every 4-8 weeks to see customers (as needed)

# Lead Learning Product Manager

CSQ227R10

Role overview

We are looking for a Lead Learning Product Manager to own the platform learning experience for Databricks customers, partners, and internal practitioners. You will sit at the intersection of product, UX, and learning science, building the systems that help data and AI teams build skills needed to become successful and confident users of the Databricks platform. 

You’ll define how users discover, practice, and demonstrate skills across in-product journeys, training, and AI-assisted guidance. You will work closely with engineering, design, curriculum, and go‑to‑market teams to translate pedagogical goals into scalable platform capabilities, from adaptive learning flows and assessments to analytics that prove real skill development.

Key responsibilities

Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI‑first learning systems on the Databricks platform, anchored on contextual, in the flow of work enablement and a unified skills infrastructure.

Design experiences that surface targeted knowledge precisely when users need it, triggered by real work context (e.g., usage patterns, errors, task types), reducing interruptions and friction.

Translate learning and pedagogical goals into platform capabilities such as learner models, skills graphs, progress tracking, adaptive learning paths, assessments, and feedback loops.

Partner with UX and content design to create intuitive, embedded guidance and learning patterns that feel like part of the workflow, not separate training destinations.

Collaborate with platform and infrastructure teams to ensure learning and skills systems are reliable, secure, performant, and able to serve global enterprise customers at scale.

Define and evolve predictive signals and analytics that give proactive visibility into emerging skills and capability gaps, enabling action before they impact business outcomes.

Build features and tooling that allow enablement teams to deliver at-scale personalization - leveraging AI and automation.

Provide employees and leaders with transparent views into skills, enablement activities, and progress toward role and organizational goals through dashboards, reports, and in‑product insights.

Work closely with education, documentation, and curriculum teams to empower them with self‑service configuration and experimentation tools for new learning experiences.

Engage directly with customers, partners, and internal field teams to deeply understand learning needs across roles and transform these into clear product requirements.

What success looks like in the first 12 months

A cohesive, AI‑first skills platform and experience is live, guiding users from first login with contextual, just‑in‑time experiences triggered by work context.

Clear, trusted metrics exist for learning efficacy and skill attainment and used to drive roadmap decisions. 

Predictive insights into emerging capability and skills gaps are available to leaders, enabling proactive interventions before they impact business performance.

Enablement teams use platform tools you defined to deliver personalized learning and guidance at scale without needing to grow headcount proportionally.

Learning and skills capabilities are integrated with broader Databricks platform features and measurably improve adoption and expansion.

Qualifications

5–8+ years of experience in product management, UX-focused product roles, or learning/education platforms, ideally within B2B SaaS, developer tools, or data/AI products.

Demonstrated experience owning a product area end to end: defining strategy and roadmap, writing PRDs, collaborating with engineering and design, and shipping impactful user-facing features.

Experience building or working on learning systems, training platforms, or content/knowledge experiences (LMS, certification, education analytics, in-product guidance, or similar).

Strong UX instincts and a track record of collaborating closely with designers and researchers to create intuitive flows, information architectures, and content experiences.

Comfort working with data: defining metrics, instrumenting experiments, and using analytics to understand user behavior, learning outcomes, and skills gaps.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to explain complex concepts simply and advocate for learners across the organization.

Experience with AI-powered learning, adaptive systems, or building products that incorporate LLMs into user workflows

FDEs deliver with customer empathy, integrating with client systems, training, and other technical needs to help customers get most value out of their data. 

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. The ideal candidate combines engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for working with customers and teammates to solve complex problems that drive measurable outcomes. FDEs are billable and know how to complete projects according to specification with exceptional customer empathy.

The impact you will have:

Production Solution Delivery: Lead impactful customer technical projects by delivering production-grade systems, designing and building reference architectures, custom applications and data ingestion and ML/AI model integration

Transformational Impact: Guide strategic customers as they implement transformational big data projects including end-to-end design, build and deployment of industry-leading big data and AI applications. Work with engagement managers to scope technical delivery work with input from the customer

Empower Customers: Guide customers on architecture and design; bootstrap or implement customer projects which leads to a customers' successful understanding, evaluation and adoption of Databricks.

Own the Architecture: Lead architecture and design decisions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with both customer needs and Databricks best practices.

Work with the Databricks technical team, Project Manager, Architect and Customer team to ensure the technical components of the engagement are delivered to meet customer's needs.

Work with Engineering and Databricks Customer Support to provide product and implementation feedback and to guide rapid resolution for engagement specific product and support issues.

Customer Immersion: Embed with customer teams, engaging with stakeholders from technical ICs to executives to deeply understand challenges and deliver impact.

Reusable Assets & Scale: Contribute accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that scale impact across accounts and influence the Databricks product roadmap.

What we look for:

6+ years experience in data engineering, data platforms & analytics, or software engineering

Comfortable writing code in either Python, Scala, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks

Working knowledge of two or more common Cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) with expertise in at least one

Deep experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark™ and knowledge of Spark runtime internals

Familiarity with CI/CD for production deployments

Working knowledge of MLOps, ML/AI models and AI APIs

Design and deployment of performant production end-to-end data architectures and applications that combine data pipelines, ML/AI models, and user-facing interfaces.

Experience with technical project delivery - managing scope, timelines and measurable outcomes, translating complex concepts into actionable solutions.

Documentation and white-boarding skills.

Experience working with enterprise clients and managing conflicts across a broad stakeholder range

Build skills in technical areas, and demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to explore new technologies which support the deployment and integration of Databricks-based solutions to complete customer projects.

Travel to customers 20% of the time

Databricks Certification

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. ## 185. 8823880002-staff-product-operations-lead-marketplace-operations

- **原文件**：databricks\8823880002-staff-product-operations-lead-marketplace-operations.md

**正文**

# Staff Product Operations Lead, Marketplace Operations

P-1495

About Databricks

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.

The Role

As enterprise AI adoption accelerates globally, the Databricks Marketplace serves as a core engine for third-party innovation, enabling organizations to discover, share, and commercialize data assets, AI models, and applications. We are looking for an Operations Lead to own and scale the end-to-end operational engine behind our Marketplace. In this high-visibility position, you will establish operational excellence across partner and transaction approvals, marketplace health, deal desk support, catalog integrity, and partner and customer retention initiatives.

This role is for a hands-on builder who is as comfortable running operations as building the tools behind them. Beyond running day-to-day workstreams, you will actively architect and deploy tools, automations, and AI-driven workflows to scale the platform. Partnering cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Field leadership, you will remove friction, shape our Marketplace product, and help guide our go-to-market direction. This is an individual-contributor role today, with the opportunity to build and lead a team as the Marketplace scales.

The Impact You’ll Have

Architect, manage, and scale end-to-end operational workflows for partner eligibility and onboarding, transaction approvals, catalog health, and featured listing placements.

Own the health and integrity of the Marketplace: monitor key signals, establish quality controls, and support Deal Desk on complex commercial transactions.

Design and deploy custom tools, automations, and AI-assisted workflows (leveraging Python, low-code tools, workflow platforms, or agentic AI) to reduce operational friction and accelerate throughput.

Drive retention campaigns and cross-functional operational cadences aligned with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Field teams.

Partner on go-to-market efforts, driving transaction pipeline growth and strategic partner and customer deals.

What We're Looking For

Minimum Qualifications

8+ years of operational leadership experience across Business Operations, Product Operations, Technical Program Management, or scaling operational functions within a fast-paced technology environment.

Demonstrated "builder" capability: hands-on experience designing and shipping automations or operational tools using a mix of Python, low-code/RPA platforms, workflow platforms, or modern AI, LLM, and agent tooling.

Proven track record of full operational ownership over end-to-end processes, approval gates, and quality control systems rather than pure analytical reporting.

Strong cross-functional collaboration and leadership skills, with a history of aligning priorities across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Field organizations.

Exceptional organizational skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to move fast and keep a high bar for accuracy in ambiguous situations.

Direct experience with enterprise software marketplaces, two-sided platform ecosystems, or cloud commerce environments.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience scaling a marketplace, platform, or commerce operation through a high-growth phase.

Familiarity with software commercial structures, Deal Desk operations, or strategic partner GTM programs.

Experience quickly adopting next-generation AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, AI agents) to streamline personal or team productivity.

Pay Range Transparency

Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. About Databricks

# Sr. Engagement Manager, FDE

CSQ128R11

The Engagement Manager is responsible for helping customers accelerate value through adoption of the Databricks platform, working with them to Strategically solve, build and sell Programs delivered by our Forward Deployed Engineering Team. 

As an Engagement Manager, you will ensure that our customers are making the most value of our products and services by positioning our FDE and training engagements.

This role is a strategic and cross-functional position that will partner closely with Sales, Field Engineering, Partners, Support and Product Teams on campaigns, programs and content to position and sell engagements that solve our Customers most complex business problems. 

You will report to the Director, Forward Deployed Engineering.

The impact you will have

Demonstrate a passion for the job and lead by example by putting Databricks and our customers first to achieve the sales and delivery mission.

Collaborate with the sales counterpart and engage early in the sales process to understand the customer’s needs, business and definition of success, ensuring expectations are exceeded in delivery and valued solutions are developed.

Identify opportunities for new services by understanding potential new Business use cases and articulating the business value of upselling or extending services.

Develop commercial models, including leveraging Databricks and partner investment vehicles, to address customer budgetary constraints.

Full accountability for meeting or exceeding FDE and Training KPIs.

Articulate relevant customer success stories, service offerings and metrics that demonstrate value to customers.

Consult with clients to understand and analyze engagement scope, requirements, time, cost and benefits.

Estimate, scope and develop statements of work as necessary.

Drive resolution of delivery challenges, resource contention and scoping issues, while managing expectations.

What we look for

Data and AI domain knowledge, with experience helping customers realize business value through production implementations.

Proven experience in senior customer-facing/services sales roles requiring influencing, validating, negotiating, understanding and execution.

Excellent customer-facing skills and the ability to build strong relationships at all levels, including with senior executives internally and externally.

A consistent track record of identifying customer needs and successfully implementing solutions.

Strong leadership experience, including enforcing project governance and driving delivery excellence.

Strong service delivery and program management skills, with the ability to translate customer-success outcomes into structured program plans.

Proven experience estimating effort and scope for services.

Proven experience meeting and achieving KPIs and targets, including CSAT, bookings and revenue.

Outstanding communication and customer relationship skills.

Language Proficiency: Native-level fluency in English and professional working proficiency in Mandarin or Bahasa (both written and verbal).

## 187. 8831555002-staff-product-manager-us-public-sector

**正文**

# Staff Product Manager, US Public Sector

RDQ427R587

At Databricks, we are passionate about helping data teams solve the world's toughest problems, from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform protected by the highest standards of security and compliance. Nowhere are those standards higher than in the US public sector.

As the Product Manager for US Public Sector, you will own the roadmap that brings the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform to every tier of the US Government mission, from federal civilian agencies and state and local governments to the Department of Defense and the Intelligence Community. Your surface spans the full accreditation spectrum: FedRAMP on commercial clouds, the sovereign AWS GovCloud and Azure Government regions, and classified environments up to Top Secret.

You will define the product strategy to identify, prioritize, and sequence where Databricks should invest next. As the voice of the government customer inside Databricks, you will shape and influence roadmaps across R&D so that our latest Data and AI innovations reach mission owners without compromising on security or sovereignty. You will partner cross-functionally with R&D, security, legal, GTM, and support teams, and directly with the public-sector field team, to enable adoption across the most demanding regulated environment in the world, empowering government customers to focus on their mission while relying on Databricks to meet the bar.

The impact you will have

Own the US public-sector product offerings end to end — from FedRAMP on commercial clouds, to AWS GovCloud and Azure Government, to DoD Impact Levels and classified environments. 

Design new features, and adapt existing ones, to meet the specific needs of the US Government and its regulated environments.

Ensure compliance and authorization processes scale with Databricks’ rapid growth and with each new region and impact level.

Launch public-sector offerings in close partnership with GTM and the public-sector field teams to accelerate adoption of Databricks’ Data and AI capabilities across federal, defense, Intelligence Community, and State, Local and Education customers.

Partner with the Security Assurance, Corporate Operations, Sales and Engineering teams to define the company-wide public-sector compliance roadmap across all clouds, prioritizing and sequencing the authorizations (FedRAMP, DoD Impact Levels, and beyond) that open new government markets.

Partner with cloud providers to coordinate product launches and obtain capabilities needed to support regulated customers.

What we look for

Product management experience with enterprise B2B or SaaS products, with experience delivering successful customer-facing products/features.

Proven ability to lead customer conversations, write PRDs, define success metrics, prioritize features, and guide engineering and design execution

Domain expertise in the US public-sector compliance and accreditation — e.g., FedRAMP, DoD Impact Levels (IL4/5/6), and NIST 800-53 — and with government cloud (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government) or classified deployments

Experience launching enterprise products and driving adoption in large, complex organizations — ideally including US Government or other highly regulated customers

Experience driving business results through influential leadership across multiple partner teams including engineering, sales, marketing, solution architects and customer success.

US citizenship and ability to obtain and hold a security clearance

[Preferred] Active US security clearance (i.e. Top Secret, or TS/SCI)

## 188. 8854693002-staff-product-designer-agentic-coding

- **原文件**：databricks\8854693002-staff-product-designer-agentic-coding.md

**正文**

# Staff Product Designer, Agentic Coding

RDQ427R613

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 10,000 organizations worldwide rely on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform to unify and democratize data, analytics, and AI. As agents move from demos to real production work, Databricks is building the platform that lets enterprises create, govern, and collaborate with coding agents safely and at scale.

Team & Product

Omnigent is Databricks' platform for building, composing, governing, and sharing AI coding agents. It lets people create and coordinate agents across different model providers and execution environments - from the CLI and IDE to desktop, mobile, and managed enterprise surfaces. Users can watch agents work live, jump in to co-drive or fork a session, and package and share reusable agents.

This is a rare chance to define and refine interaction patterns at enterprise scale: how people supervise fleets of agents, intervene at the right moment, understand risk, and build trust in autonomous work - starting with coding, review, and exploration workflows. The hard design problem isn't just showing what agents are doing; it's helping people know when to trust, when to step in, and how to recover when work goes off track - across a high-density desktop workspace and lightweight mobile moments.

You'll design for two audiences at once: an open-source community shaping the future of agent workflows, and enterprise teams adopting agents in governed production.

Role

You'll be the IC design lead for how humans and fleets of agents work together on Omnigent - leading through product strategy, systems thinking, craft, and cross-functional collaboration. You're equally comfortable shipping small design changes directly in the codebase and prototyping your way through big, ambiguous problems that don't have a spec yet.

You'll own the design direction across desktop and mobile, partner deeply with engineering and product, and translate the frontier of what agents can do into experiences that feel clear, controllable, trustworthy, and surprisingly effortless.

What you'll do

Own the desktop and mobile experience for live agent sessions end to end - from strategy and interaction models to visual polish and shipped detail. Shape the high-density orchestration workflows on desktop and the lightweight monitoring, review, approval, and intervention moments on mobile.

Design directly in the codebase for well-scoped changes, working alongside engineers to ship real improvements rather than handing off static mocks.

Use prototypes as a primary thinking tool. For large, vague problems, build interactive prototypes to explore, de-risk, and align the team on a direction.

Invent the interaction language for agentic work: real-time multi-agent sessions, watch/co-drive/fork flows, human-in-the-loop approvals, agent status and transparency, error and recovery states, and trust.

Define durable UX principles and interaction frameworks for agent collaboration, approvals, observability, and recovery that other teams reuse across Omnigent surfaces.

Drive cross-platform consistency with a strong, scalable design system spanning desktop and mobile.

Ground decisions in evidence - use research instincts and real usage to pressure-test ideas and know what to build next.

What we're looking for

A builder-designer who works fluently with AI tools. You can make small design changes directly in a codebase, and you use prototypes - and the agents themselves - to explore larger, ambiguous problems. You regularly use AI tools in your own design and build workflow.

A portfolio of strong end-to-end craft - interaction design, visual/UI polish, and design-systems thinking - ideally on developer tools, AI/ML products, enterprise software, or other products for technical users.

Staff-level scope and impact. A track record of shipping complex, high-quality developer products and leading design direction on hard problems.

Self-directed, and comfortable in ambiguity - you help shape product direction when the path isn't defined.

A strong collaborator who raises the level of high-quality critique, clear decision-making, and tight partnership with engineering and product.

Nice to have

Experience designing coding tools, IDEs, agent frameworks, or developer platforms.

Familiarity with multi-agent systems, LLM harnesses, or governance/observability tooling.

# Senior / Staff Product Engineer

At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. 

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

As a small team, we’re all generalists that work across the full stack (built in Typescript end-to-end). We’re looking for experienced engineers that thrive in an environment of autonomy and individual responsibility to help us build the future of product development.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in the US and Europe. You can work from anywhere within these regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

Work closely with founders and design to implement new concepts and ideas

Build AI-powered functionality into the core of Linear

Update our realtime collaborative content editor used across all internal surfaces

Build new user-facing features with beautiful and scalable UI components

Obsessively improve application performance

Refine our software development processes to keep the team operating at high velocity

What we're looking for

5+ years of experience building customer-facing products at a high-quality software company

Strong React and TypeScript fundamentals, with experience across the full stack (Browser technologies, Node, GraphQL, PostgreSQL)

Track record of driving complex, end-to-end features (not just incremental improvements and refactors) with visible impact on the product

Product sensibility: you care about UX, speed, and polish, and you push back when something doesn't feel right

Comfortable working without heavy PM overhead; you can help to shape the problem, not just implement a solution

High ownership mentality: self-directed, full-lifecycle builder who takes a feature from idea to shipped

Thrives in a remote, async-first environment with a lean, high-output team

Experience at a startup or a company with a genuinely high engineering bar

Our tech

This stack reflects the systems we build and operate. You’re not expected to have experience with everything listed, but you should be excited to work close to product, performance, and real-world scale.

Agentic workload system utilizing temporal, operating at production scale

Proprietary websocket data sync framework built for speed and offline support

React, MobX, styled-components on the frontend

Extensive, widely used, GraphQL API and SDK

Node, Postgres, Temporal, and Redis in the backend

Hosted on Google Cloud with k8s

GitHub, Slack, Notion

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

Competitive salary and equity

Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

Paid co-working space or desk

Health coverage (based on country requirements)

5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

4 months paid parental leave

Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

Regular team events and off-sites

Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

Read Me a story about our mission

Our hiring process: How we hire at Linear

How we work: Designing remote work at Linear

Why and how we do work trials Linear blog post

How we use AI in design feature of Linear's design team

Scaling our real-time sync engine talk by our cofounder, Tuomas Artman, at Linear's 2023 offsite

Our recent tender offer: Sharing Linear’s growth with the people building it

Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

A note on recruitment fraud: all official Linear hiring communication comes from an @linear.app email address, and all open roles are listed at linear.app/careers. We never ask candidates for payment or financial information. Suspicious messages can be reported to security@linear.app.

Pair closely with engineering and product to initiate and complete roadmap projects, no hand-offs

Use and improve our lightweight design system components

7+ years experience designing software

Ability to distill problems and feedback, then design clear, focused solutions

Effective written and verbal communication skills — much of our work is async

# Product Marketing Manager

At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. You’ll go deep on the product, define positioning and messaging, and drive execution across the surfaces that matter most—from in-product copy and changelogs to enablement, documentation inputs, email, and launch communications. Create and coordinate launch deliverables such as changelogs, demos, enablement materials, email, social copy, and go-to-market communications

Equip Sales, CX, and other customer-facing teams with the context and materials they need to communicate new launches effectively

Bring customer insight, product understanding, and market context back into product and launch decisions

Exceptional writing and editorial judgment, with the ability to make complex ideas feel clear and compelling

At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

We’re looking for experienced engineers who have shipped applied AI systems to production and want to define what the agent-native future looks like. We are building intelligence into the core of Linear, enabling the product to orchestrate coding, proactively move work forward, and power-up every software team.

You’ll work closely with product and design to transform foundation models into structured, reliable workflows embedded deeply in the core of Linear. We care deeply about keeping Linear fast, intuitive, and opinionated—AI is no exception.

Product sensibility: you care about UX, speed, and polish, and you push back when something doesn't feel right

Comfortable working without heavy PM overhead; you can help to shape the problem, not just implement a solution

High ownership mentality: self-directed, full-lifecycle builder who takes a feature from idea to shipped

Thrives in a remote, async-first environment with a lean, high-output team

Experience at a startup or a company with a genuinely high engineering bar

# Principal Product Designer

At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. 

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Quality is our competitive advantage. Every member of our fully remote team is a maker at heart, caring deeply about the quality and feel of our work. While the industry optimizes for speed and metrics alone, we believe that craft and quality have lasting value. Quality creates gravity — it pulls people toward our team and product rather than requiring us to push. This philosophy drives everything we do, from product decisions to hiring choices.

For this role, we expect robust design skills, sharp product thinking, and the ability to engage in technical discussions. We work in small, autonomous project teams, where engineers are paired tightly with designers to explore ideas, build prototypes, deploy internal builds, and ultimately ship to customers. You will be a key element of projects from beginning to end.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America and Europe. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

Pair closely with engineering and product to initiate and complete roadmap projects, no hand-offs

Spot opportunities to redesign or refine key screens and flows, as well as smaller quality issues and “paper cuts” as you use Linear

Create mockups, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals to communicate ideas and describe their execution

Guide and inspire fellow designers through collaborative critique of work-in-progress

Use and improve our lightweight design system components

Help with hiring new teammates that can elevate our team and product

What we’re looking for

7+ years experience designing software

Courage to ask questions, experiment, and advocate for what you feel is right

Humility to accept feedback, adapt your thinking, and iterate toward the best solution

Experience with prototyping in Figma (and beyond with tools like AI, HTML/CSS, Origami)

Ability to distill problems and feedback, then design clear, focused solutions

Effective written and verbal communication skills — much of our work is async

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

Competitive salary and equity

Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

Paid co-working space or desk

Health coverage (based on country requirements)

5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

4 months paid parental leave

Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

Regular team events and off-sites

Remote-first with no required commute

What you'll do

Build beautiful, responsive websites, landing pages, and internal tools

Explore visual design in Figma and translate it to web-native experiences

What we're looking for

Eye for good design

Strong frontend engineering skills

Experience building end-to-end websites and landing pages

Experience with React and TypeScript

Experience using agentic coding tools as part of the design process (from exploring ideas to building production-quality interactions)

A portfolio or Twitter profile showcasing a range of technical skills, a creative use of code, and prototyping skills

What we offer

Interesting and challenging work

Work life balance

Competitive salary and equity

Employee-friendly equity terms (extended exercise)

Paid lunch and coffee during work days

Work remotely, no commuting to the office

# AI产品经理实习生

AI产品经理实习生 250-260元/天
深圳 5天/周 2个月 本科

职位描述

我们是一支位于深圳、面向海外市场的年轻 AI Native 创业团队，正在打造 AI 硬件定制平台——用户从一句话或一张参考图出发，就能定制能真实运行的硬件。AI 工具贯穿我们的研究、内容、设计和开发全流程。欢迎不同专业、院校和经历的伙伴，也欢迎跨专业探索、自学成长的学弟加入。

工作范围：
- 参与用户访谈、产品体验和反馈整理，发现真实问题，梳理需求和优先级。
- 用 AI 工具搭建可体验的 Demo，设计核心流程与交互，把想法变成可讨论、可验证的方案。
- 与产品、工程同事协作，明确关键规则和验收标准，推进功能验证和上线。
- 跟进使用数据、用户反馈和体验问题，参与下一轮迭代，逐步独立负责一个具体功能。

我们希望你
- 本科或硕士在读，专业不限，无需产品相关实习经历；有责任心、做事靠谱、能主动沟通、推进任务。
- 保持好奇心和想象力，愿意了解用户，能清晰表达问题与想法，并动手验证自己的判断。
- 熟练使用 AI 工具做研究、做 Demo、验证方案，关注输出是否真正解决了问题。
- 对工程、运营或设计中的至少一个方向有持续兴趣，愿意结合产品工作主动探索。

你会得到什么
- 真实项目与快速迭代：亲自接触用户，参与产品从需求、方案到上线的全过程，在真实反馈中积累产品判断力。
- 独立负责与自主空间：在团队支持下，逐步独立负责一款产品或一个功能；对齐目标后自主探索方案、跟进落地和迭代。
- AI 资源与团队支持：日常所需的 AI 工具和 Token 报销，和同事直接协作，在实践中快速成长。
- 每个人都有发言权：可以提问、提建议、表达不同意见，实习生的想法同样会被认真对待。
- 主攻明确、成长不设限：岗位职责清晰，但能力发展的空间没有上限。你可以先独立负责一块业务，再根据兴趣、能力和成果拓展到产品、工程、运营或设计等方向。
- 实习生薪资按天计算，每天250元，接受投递【转写不确定：此处字符模糊】

投递方式
请注明"产品实习生"、可到岗时间、每周到岗天数和预计实习时长。欢迎附上用 AI 做过的 Demo、原型或小工具，简述想解决的问题和你的贡献。课程作业、个人项目均可

AI 创新专项实习生（产品定义…） 200-300元/天
深圳 3天/周 2个月 学历不限

职位描述

这是一个普通的实习岗位，AI 做一件全新的事——不只是硬件，不只是软件。
而是探索【转写不确定：原文约3字被遮挡，似为某产品概念】等类似全新产品的边界。
它可能会是什么样形态，我们还没有答案，我们需要的，是愿意真正把这件事当成自己的事去做的人。

你会得到什么：
没有预设的任务清单，大方向是：
- 发现一个值得做的问题：从行业动态、竞品动向和用户真实场景里，找到值得做的方向
- 做产品调研：拆到底是背后的需求逻辑，而不是罗列表参数【转写不确定：语句顺序或有误】

- 定色产品方向后【转写不确定：或为"确定"】，把调研结论写改成产品定义【转写不确定：或为"转化"】，写清楚：在什么场景、我在怎么解决、为什么非你不好【转写不确定：或为"为什么非它不可"】
- 用懂 AI 工作快速试【转写不确定】迭代、估算、复盘、重新出发
- 有一些自己的玩法，希望从某一个领域深度研究，或者就是热爱这个领域的爱好者
- 学习动力：运动锻炼、公影轮等【转写不确定：原文模糊】

（中段，关于人的标准）
我们不在乎学历、专业、GPA，也不在乎你来自哪所学校。
我们只在乎：
AI 已经是你日常的一部分，不是偶尔用
你每个人都有实际的核心—一项既讲清楚【转写不确定：此句转写不可靠】
你能想很周到，遇到复杂问题会列第一性原理，不套现成框架
你足够嘴硬，方案没定论时，你能拿到论证去投射【转写不确定：或为"论证去说服"】，而不是等着人给答案

# Product Builder（AI社交向）

薪资面议 深圳 实习 / Junior / Senior 全职 18天前

使命：一起构建下一代的 Agentic 社交网络

工作内容

需求从起心动念到上线验收，你带着 agent 自己走完；

每天面对的是真实的 badcase、trace、用户评价，自己给自己下需求；

你 build 的东西会直接决定几十万人的分身怎么说话、怎么社交、怎么连接。

岗位要求

Top 院校毕业，专业不限；工作经验 3 年以内；

高度 AI native，vibe coding "筑基期"以上；有自己实际 build 过的小东西；

对 LLM 的能力边界有一手体感；对 Agent、记忆、召回等有所涉猎；

有独特的（模型分布之外的）taste；

这个年纪应有的少年感（好奇心与野心）。

我们能提供的

有竞争力的薪酬（不管你之前多少我们先加 20% 为敬）；

有大希望的期权（希望是指那部分期权是可能让你一夜财富自由的）；

这个时代最激进的 AI-native 工作流，在这里一年等于人间 10 年；

每月 600 美金+ 的订阅额度（Claude 和 Codex 双开打底）；

最为关键的，是能够与一群 Crazyones 一起做这个时代最困难且最重要的事情！

# AI产品经理

¥30k – ¥40k/月 · 13薪 深圳 全职 1个月前

职责
- 从用户数据、真实对话、用户访谈和产品体验中，找到最值得解决的问题，并判断产品优先级；
- 独立 Owner 核心产品方向，从问题定义、方案探索、验证、上线到数据复盘形成完整闭环；
- 建立数据驱动的产品工作方式，能够独立完成 retention、cohort、funnel、segmentation、session 等分析；
- 通过 Prototype、用户测试、A/B Test 等方式快速验证产品假设，减少无效开发；
- 将产品目标转化为清晰的需求、成功指标、验收标准和体验定义。

能力要求
- 5 年以上 C 端产品经验，完整负责过产品或核心业务模块；
- 有优秀的 Product Judgment，能够区分表面现象、真实需求和真正的产品机会；
- 数据能力扎实，熟练 SQL，能够独立完成常见产品分析；
- 有较强用户洞察能力，愿意持续看真实用户、真实 Session 和用户反馈；
- 熟悉实验设计，习惯通过证据验证而不是依赖直觉做产品；
- 有较强的产品定义和跨团队推动能力；
- 深度使用 AI 工具，理解 LLM、Agent、Memory、Tool Calling、Latency 等基本机制。

加分项（选填）
- Consumer AI / AI Companion / 社交 / 内容 / 游戏经验
- Python / Pandas / Jupyter
- Subscription、Growth 或海外 C 端产品经验
- 从 0 到 1 新产品或新品类经验

# 资深UI设计师

¥20k – ¥35k/月 上海 · 珠海 · 深圳 全职 13天前

岗位职责：
负责国际化产品UI/UX设计工作，覆盖Web端、APP端等产品，独立完成交互构思、视觉落地、迭代优化全流程工作。
主导产品整体视觉风格，结合行业审美、品牌调性搭建视觉体系，打磨产品质感，打造高辨识度、去同质化的产品界面。
深度贴合AI产品特性，针对对话交互、任务流转、工具调用、工作流编排、数据展示等核心场景，优化整体用户体验与界面视觉表现。
联动产品、研发、算法团队，拆解复杂AI能力，转化为简洁美观、易用高效的产品界面，推进设计高品质落地。

岗位要求：
1. 3年以上UI/UX设计经验，具备多终端（APP/PC/Web）设计经验，可独立完成从交互到视觉的全流程设计。
2. 拥有顶尖视觉审美，精通版式、色彩、层级、字体、光影等设计原理，擅长打造简约高级、国际化审美的设计风格。
3. 熟练使用Figma、PS、AI等主流设计工具，熟悉各终端设计适配规范，可独立定义产品视觉风格、搭建设计规范。
4. 具备优秀的需求理解能力与跨团队协作能力，能平衡产品实用性、用户体验与视觉质感。

加分项：
1. 过往同时具备APP/PC/网页端设计项目经验，熟练运用AI工具；
2. 拥有国际化海外产品设计经验，可跟进海外前沿AI设计趋势。

1、项目管理：协助各产品负责人，负责公司AI产品(包含AI硬件与软件)的需求定义与落地，达成商业数据和用户体验目标，完成对内，对外的需求管理及沟通协调，监控产品研发质量，推动开发进度；
2、需求分析整理：以目标用户的体验为核心，对新技术，国内外产品，相关体系进行研究，通过用户调研，反馈收集和数据分析等方式获取用户需求，协助产品总监提炼有效的产品方向。并设计和实施AI产品的策略，以满足特定行业需求；
3、跨职能协同：联动内外部资源，如硬件，软件，供应链，市场等合作伙伴，制定项目里程碑，识另并解决落地难点与资源冲突，推进提升产品力。
4、AI工具使用：会编写较为复杂的prompt，懂得市面上常见的prompt结构。能够使用扣子，dify等工具搭建workflow，并借助Al工具批量生产内容

## 任职要求

1、可至少实习3个月，上下班时间自目由，但需按时完成工作内容，公司将为符合岗位要求的同学提供转正机会；
2、处于AI相关专业领域，有模型微调经验者优先，可通过搭建Al流程，优化prompt，提升产品体验，合理处理数据隐私和伦理问题；
3、对AI行业敏感度高，能跟踪AI技术的最新发展及市场动态，了解市场近期变化和技术突破；
4、具备出色的逻辑思维和数据分析能力，对用户体验敏感；
5、有自驱意识和较强学习能力，能快速拓展知识范围，灵活变通。

# AI产品实习生（广州智跃深空）

¥200 – ¥300/日 · 广州 · 海珠区 · 唯品会大厦安越楼23层 · 实习 · 全职 · 1 个月前

## 职位亮点

1. 项目/业务亮点：深度参与AI产品从0到1的研发全流程，接触RAG、Agent架构等前沿技术，实践Prompt调优与模型评测。
2. 成长/发展亮点：一对一导师带教，优秀同学毕业后可提供转正机会。
3. 团队/文化亮点：扁平化技术团队，氛围有爱融洽。
4. 薪酬福利亮点：弹性工作制，180-250元/天的实习津贴，每天下午茶。

## 岗位职责

1. 协助开展AI产品的市场调研与用户需求分析，参与用户访谈、竞品体验，输出调研分析报告。
2. 在导师指导下，参与AI功能模块的需求定义、PRD文档撰写及原型设计，重点跟进prompt调优、模型效果评测与落地场景打磨。
3. 协助跟进产品研发全流程，协调研发团队，同步项目进度；参与功能验收与模型效果测试，保障交付质量。
4. 跟踪大模型、RAG、Agent架构等前沿技术动态及行业应用案例，输出技术趋势与产品创新分析，为产品迭代提供输入。
5. 协助收集用户反馈及产品埋点数据，进行基础数据分析，提炼优化建议，推动产品体验持续改进。

## 任职要求

1. 本科及以上在读或应届毕业生，计算机科学、人工智能、软件工程等相关专业优先。
2. 对AI行业有强烈热情，主动尝试并深度使用多种AI生成工具。
3. 具备清晰的逻辑思维与问题拆解能力，优秀的沟通表达与跨团队协作能力，自驱力强。
4. 掌握Axure、Figma、Xmind等产品设计工具；具备基础数据分析能力（Excel、SQL），能独立提取并分析用户行为数据。

## 加分项（非必须，但会加分）

1. 有产品实习经验或AI相关项目经历（如AI应用demo、模型评测、Agent搭建等）。

# 【实习】AI技术产品实习生

【实习】AI技术产品实习生 240-300元/天
深圳·福田区 硕士 实习（招1人，3个月，4天/周，提供实习证明）
标签：央企 / 大数据 / 产品经理

【岗位职责 】
1. AI技术应用与工作流搭建 (40%):
基于大模型（LLM）能力，利用Dify、Coze、LangChain或原生代码进行AI Agent（智能体）的搭建与调试。
探索MCP (Model Context Protocol) 在数据加工场景下的应用，尝试将现有工具/数据接口与AI模型连接。
设计并优化内部工作流（Workflow），利用AI工具提升团队在数据处理、文档编写等环节的效率。
2. 产品调研与分析 (30%):
针对数据加工/数据处理领域进行竞品分析与行业调研，输出有深度的调研报告。
协助产品经理挖掘业务需求，从技术可行性角度（特别是AI能力边界）提出产品优化建议。
3. 产品质量保障与测试 (30%):
负责数据平台功能的日常功能性测试，确保产品交付质量。
通过测试深入理解业务逻辑，整理测试报告，反馈Bug并追踪修复进度。
维护产品帮助文档或知识库。

【任职要求 】
1、硕士及以上学历在读（研一/研二优先），优先考虑粤港澳大湾区（香港、澳门、广东）高校学生。
2、计算机科学、人工智能、信息系统、软件工程或理工科背景，同时对产品管理感兴趣者极佳。
3、技能要求：
AI素养： 重度ChatGPT/Claude/Midjourney用户，熟悉Prompt Engineering（提示词工程），了解主流LLM的区别。
技术基础： 具备基本的编程逻辑，熟悉 Python 者优先；了解API调用、JSON格式数据结构。
动手能力： 有过Agent搭建经验（如使用Coze/Dify/GPTs）或了解MCP协议概念者。
4、综合素质：
极强的学习驱力： 愿意主动钻研新概念（如MCP、RAG），不仅是"想学"，而是"能快速上手"。
细致耐心： 测试工作需要极大的耐心和严谨，能够接受从基础的测试工作中积累产品认知的过程。

【岗位福利】
1、前沿技术实践： 亲手落地Agent、Workflow、MCP等AI前沿概念。
2、复合能力增长： 在一家数据公司同时获得"产品定义"与"技术实现"的双重视角。
3、导师带教： 央企实习证明。
4、实习薪资：240-300元/天+全勤奖。

# Product Manager, Sensitive Deployments

About the Team

The Integrity team builds the systems OpenAI uses to understand, prevent, and respond to misuse across our products. We partner with Product, Policy, Safety Systems, User Operations, Security, Legal, Privacy, OpenAI for Government, and research teams to turn policy and threat models into product controls, review workflows, measurement systems, and enforcement paths.

About the Role

We are hiring a Product Manager to own Integrity's product strategy for sensitive deployments: contexts where model capability, customer or deployment setting, privacy constraints, and misuse potential make the operating bar unusually high. This includes government and other high stakes deployments, regulated or high-trust enterprise contexts, zero data retention and privacy-constrained environments, and agentic workflows where harm can unfold across many steps rather than a single prompt.

The Sensitive Deployments PM will focus on high-consequence use cases relevant to government deployments and broader deployment-readiness questions for high-risk domains (e.g., healthcare), while building reusable Integrity capabilities for agentic detection and enforcements in these environments.

This position is based in San Francisco, CA, with relocation assistance available.

In this role, you will:

Own the roadmap for sensitive deployment Integrity controls and readiness criteria.

Define how we measure residual risk, decision quality, review quality, and mitigation effectiveness.

Build agentic investigation and context-assembly workflows for complex, multi-step misuse patterns.

Partner with Policy, Legal, Privacy, Safety Systems, User Ops, Government, and product teams to build shared capabilities.

Create launch and deployment playbooks for sensitive customer, capability, and product contexts.

You might thrive in this role if you:

Have shipped complex product systems in AI, integrity, trust and safety, security, privacy, risk, government, regulated enterprise, or AI safety.

Can turn ambiguous policy and threat-model questions into product requirements, metrics, operational workflows, and tradeoff frameworks.

Are energized by agentic AI products and want to build the platform layer that makes them safer to deploy.

Care about security, privacy, and responsible deployment, while still wanting to build concrete product systems.

# Industry Product Marketing Manager

About the Team

Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes to our broader mission of ensuring responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. With that aim in mind, we are responsible for developing and executing strategies that drive awareness, engagement, and usage for OpenAI’s products and platform amongst our core audiences. Our focus extends beyond just promoting product features; we aim to provide valuable insights and resources that help our users make the most out of AI technologies.

About the Role

As an Industry PMM, you will help define how OpenAI brings frontier AI to priority industries. This role sits at the center of OpenAI’s industry marketing motion, helping customers understand where AI can create practical value, improve workflows, and support responsible adoption.

You will shape the market narrative, build the field-facing operating system, and coordinate cross-functional execution across product launches, customer proof, partner moments, events, and account-based campaigns. You will help senior industry leaders understand how OpenAI models, products, and workflows can support meaningful work in either Life Sciences, Banking, or Healthcare.

We’re looking for a product marketer who can combine strategic narrative, technical curiosity, enterprise GTM judgment, and program leadership. The right person can turn fast-moving capability into clear positioning, credible assets, and practical field execution.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

Own positioning and messaging for OpenAI’s industry offering for either Life Sciences, Banking, or Healthcare.

Build field-ready assets for account directors, solution engineers, industry leaders, and executive audiences, including first-call decks, one-pagers, use-case libraries, customer stories, and proof-point packages

Translate frontier model capabilities into simple, accurate, and defensible GTM language for senior enterprise buyers and industry practitioners

Develop campaigns and activation programs across launches, blogs, webinars, roundtables, executive briefings, conferences, customer proof, and account-based motions

Serve as the connective tissue for the industry marketing workstream, keeping priorities, owners, launch readiness, open questions, and executive updates clear

Maintain a high bar for accuracy, governance, customer trust, and responsible marketing in a sensitive and fast-moving category

You might thrive in this role if you have:

Have 6+ years of experience in product marketing, industry marketing, vertical marketing, enterprise GTM, or adjacent B2B technology roles

PMM experience in either Life Sciences, Banking, Healthcare, or another regulated/high-trust vertical.

Have experience marketing technical enterprise products to industry, developer, IT, business, operational, or C-suite audiences

Can translate complex model, product, and technical concepts into clear positioning, field assets, and customer-facing narratives

Have strong cross-functional program leadership instincts and can drive work across Product, GTM, Comms, Partnerships, Policy, Legal, Customer Success, and Research

Use customer evidence, field signal, product usage, market research, and competitive context to sharpen strategy and prioritize work

Have experience building GTM programs, operating rhythms, or new playbooks in ambiguous, high-velocity environments

Bring strong writing, messaging, and editorial judgment, with a high bar for clarity, quality, accuracy, and credibility

Are deeply curious about AI, industry transformation, enterprise adoption, and how new capabilities become real customer value

Think strategically about how industry marketing drives awareness, trust, pipeline, adoption, customer proof, and long-term market leadership

Are highly collaborative and effective at influencing senior stakeholders, field teams, technical teams, and external partners

# Hardware Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure Partner Operations

About the Team

The Industrial Compute team is responsible for building the physical infrastructure that powers OpenAI’s largest-scale AI systems. We design, deploy, and operate next-generation compute infrastructure across a rapidly expanding global footprint, combining OpenAI-owned infrastructure with strategic cloud and infrastructure partners to support frontier AI workloads.

As our infrastructure footprint grows, operational excellence across third-party providers becomes increasingly critical. Our team ensures external infrastructure partners consistently deliver the reliability, performance, and operational maturity required to support OpenAI’s rapidly expanding compute environment.

About the Role

We are seeking a Hardware Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure Partner Operations to lead operational delivery across OpenAI’s third-party infrastructure partners, including major cloud service providers and strategic compute vendors.

In this role, you will serve as the primary operational program manager for external infrastructure partners, driving accountability for service delivery, operational readiness, incident management, performance reporting, and continuous operational improvement. You will work closely with partner engineering and operations teams while coordinating internally across Hardware Engineering, Infrastructure Operations, Capacity Planning, Networking, Supply Chain, Deployment, Reliability Engineering, and executive leadership.

Success in this role requires someone who understands how hyperscale infrastructure organizations operate, can establish strong operational governance with external partners, and is comfortable driving complex technical programs without direct ownership of the underlying infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

Own operational engagement with third-party infrastructure providers, ensuring consistent execution against operational commitments, service-level agreements (SLAs), and performance expectations.

Develop operational governance frameworks with strategic partners, including business reviews, operational scorecards, escalation processes, executive reporting, and performance improvement plans.

Define, track, and continuously improve key operational metrics related to infrastructure availability, deployment execution, incident response, operational health, service quality, and partner performance.

Build dashboards and reporting mechanisms that provide clear visibility into partner operational performance, risks, trends, and areas requiring executive attention.

Drive cross-functional coordination between OpenAI teams and external infrastructure providers to resolve operational issues, remove execution blockers, and improve delivery outcomes.

Lead operational escalations involving infrastructure availability, deployment execution, hardware operations, capacity delivery, or service performance, ensuring timely resolution and clear executive communication.

Establish repeatable operating rhythms with external partners, including weekly operational reviews, executive business reviews, service reviews, action tracking, and long-term improvement initiatives.

Partner with Capacity Planning, Hardware Operations, Networking, Deployment, Reliability Engineering, and Supply Chain teams to ensure external infrastructure providers remain aligned with OpenAI’s operational priorities.

Identify systemic operational risks across partner organizations and proactively drive corrective actions that improve long-term operational effectiveness.

Qualifications

7+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Infrastructure Operations, Cloud Operations, Service Delivery, or Technical Account Management within large-scale infrastructure environments.

Experience managing operational relationships with external infrastructure providers, cloud service providers, hardware vendors, or strategic technology partners.

Strong understanding of hyperscale cloud infrastructure, data center operations, infrastructure delivery, or large-scale distributed systems.

Experience developing operational KPIs, SLAs, service health metrics, dashboards, and executive reporting for complex technical organizations.

Demonstrated success leading cross-functional operational programs involving both internal stakeholders and external partners.

Strong program management skills with the ability to drive accountability across organizations without direct authority.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting operational performance to senior technical and executive leadership.

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Operations, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Skills

Experience managing cloud infrastructure operations within organizations such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), or other hyperscale cloud providers.

Experience leading operational governance, service delivery, customer success engineering, technical account management, or infrastructure operations for enterprise cloud customers.

Strong understanding of service-level agreements (SLAs), operational KPIs, incident management, escalation processes, root cause analysis, and continuous service improvement methodologies.

Experience building executive dashboards, operational scorecards, business review frameworks, and data-driven performance reporting.

Familiarity with infrastructure operations supporting GPU infrastructure, AI infrastructure, high-performance computing (HPC), or hyperscale data center environments.

Experience managing complex cross-company technical relationships while balancing customer priorities, engineering constraints, and operational execution.

Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders across both internal teams and external partner organizations without direct authority.

Experience driving continuous operational improvements through metrics, process optimization, and structured governance.

# Growth Marketing, Creative and Ad Operations

About the Team

The Growth team drives user and revenue growth across ChatGPT’s consumer and business segments as well as other OpenAI products worldwide. We operate across the full funnel - from awareness and acquisition through activation, retention, and expansion - using a combination of global performance marketing, AI-powered workflows, in-product optimization, insights, experimentation, and creative ops engineering.

Our Growth Marketing team is a rapidly scaling functional area, accelerating growth by connecting out-of-product and in-product experiences into seamless journeys that acquire, retain, and re-engage users, unlocking ChatGPT’s transformative potential in users’ daily lives. We work cross-functionally with product, engineering, design, data science, finance, and marketing to unlock scalable growth levers and deliver measurable impact across diverse markets.

This team thrives on rapid testing, rigorous measurement, and creative problem solving, all while keeping user value at the center of our decision-making.

About the Role

In this role, you will build and run the creative and advertising operations system that powers OpenAI’s paid marketing programs. You will connect Creative and Growth Marketing teams, establish clear processes for producing and launching high-quality ads, and keep the operational details behind paid campaigns organized, accurate, and scalable.

You will help translate growth priorities into creative briefs and testing roadmaps, coordinate assets and approvals across internal teams and external partners, and turn performance results into clear next steps.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

Build and manage the end-to-end paid creative operating system, including creative intake, briefing, production, asset delivery, approvals, trafficking, launch, reporting, and iteration.

Serve as the day-to-day connector between Creative, Brand, Growth Marketing, agencies, and production partners, keeping priorities and timelines clear and on track.

Partner with Growth Marketing to build and maintain creative testing roadmaps, translating campaign goals, audience insights, and performance data into briefs, hypotheses, test plans, and clear success metrics.

Develop and maintain the tools and processes that keep creative production organized, including asset libraries, production calendars, naming conventions, tagging, version control, specifications, and documentation.

Track creative test results, document learnings, and partner with Growth Marketing and Creative to identify what is working, what needs to change, and what should be tested next.

Continuously improve workflows, templates, reporting, and automation to increase creative throughput, reduce errors, and make paid marketing operations more efficient and reliable.

You might thrive in this role if you:

7+ years of experience in creative operations, growth or performance marketing, integrated marketing, or a related role supporting paid marketing programs.

Exceptional attention to detail and operational rigor, with a track record of owning high precision work in either creative or campaign operations.

Experience building or improving creative production workflows, project trackers, asset libraries, approval processes, and other systems that help teams execute consistently.

Hands-on familiarity with major paid advertising platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, or LinkedIn, including campaign trafficking, asset requirements, and launch QA.

Working knowledge of marketing tracking and measurement, including UTMs, pixels, conversion events, platform reporting, and basic campaign or creative performance analysis.

Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines, keep stakeholders aligned, surface risks early, and follow through on details.

Clear written and verbal communication, strong cross-functional collaboration skills, and the ability to turn growth priorities into actionable briefs, testing plans, and next steps.

Comfort working in a fast-moving environment and a proactive, resourceful approach to solving problems; experience with billing, invoicing, vendor management, or workflow automation is a plus.

# Research Engineer / Research Scientist - Personal AGI, Personalization 

About the Team

The Personalization-Memory team, within OpenAI's broader Personal AGI organization, is focused on developing agents that can learn from prior interactions in order to become more helpful and efficient over time. We build general-purpose memory and personalization capabilities that transfer across ChatGPT and other agentic products, and we collaborate with applied engineering on the product surfaces that allow users to interact with memory.

About the Role

As a Research Engineer / Research Scientist on the Personalization-Memory team, you will research and develop improvements to memory usage and personalization in OpenAI's frontier models. Our team works on reinforcement learning, dataset creation, evaluations, and other post-training methods. We partner closely with research and product teams across the company to realize the vision of a truly personalized ChatGPT.

We're looking for individuals who have a background in frontier model post-training, are able to iterate quickly, and who are passionate about product-driven research.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

Own and pursue a research agenda for improving memory use and personalization in frontier models.

Build robust evaluations for tracking modeling improvements.

Design, implement, test, and debug code across our research stack.

Collaborate closely with the research and product teams to influence the shape of technical solutions in the product.

You might thrive in this role if you:

Are passionate about personalization and building personalized assistants.

Have experience working with user signals and human data to turn feedback into reliable signals for training and evaluation.

Value principled approaches and research craftsmanship.

# Systems Software Engineer, Security, First Party Hardware

About the Team

OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. Building on efforts like Jalapeño, the team is developing future generations of AI-native silicon and tightly integrated systems to power the next generation of frontier models. By co-designing chips, systems, tools, and methodologies, the team helps deliver faster, more efficient, and production-ready hardware for OpenAI’s supercomputing platform.

About the Role

We're seeking a Security Engineer to join our First-Party Hardware team. In this role, you will own the end-to-end security foundation for OpenAI's first-party AI hardware systems, working across hardware security, embedded security, system security, and practical deployment at data center scale.

You will partner with silicon, hardware, firmware, infrastructure, manufacturing, operations, and security teams to define and deliver system-level device trust. This includes boot integrity, device identity, provisioning, attestation, management-plane security, storage encryption, debug controls, firmware update and recovery, RMA, and decommissioning. You will be accountable for turning threat models into requirements, requirements into implementation, and implementation into validation evidence that can support launch decisions.

Location: San Francisco, CA (Hybrid: 3 days/week onsite)

Relocation assistance available.

In this role, you will:

Own security requirements, threat models, validation strategy, and launch-readiness evidence for first-party hardware platforms from early design through production deployment.

Design and review secure boot, measured boot, roots of trust, platform firmware resilience, firmware signing, recovery, and anti-rollback strategies across heterogeneous devices.

Own device identity, provisioning, enrollment, attestation, certificate lifecycle, and key-management requirements across manufacturing and data center bring-up.

Harden management interfaces and operational access paths across BMCs, hosts, accelerators, switches, and service tooling, including TLS/mTLS, Redfish, gNMI, SSH, syslog, and break-glass workflows.

Drive security requirements for manufacturing, supply chain, firmware/image signing, storage encryption, RMA, repair, and decommissioning processes.

Build and drive validation for security-critical hardware and firmware behavior, including debug lockout, lifecycle transitions, update paths, attestation evidence, and recovery flows.

Partner with vendors and contract manufacturers to turn security requirements into concrete deliverables, test evidence, and launch gates.

Drive end-to-end closure across design, implementation, manufacturing readiness, deployment readiness, fleet operations, and incident response when security issues arise.

Investigate hardware and firmware security issues, assess exploitability and operational risk, and drive durable fixes with engineering owners.

You might thrive in this role if you have: 

7+ years of hands-on experience, or exceptional accomplishments demonstrating equivalent expertise, in hardware security, embedded security, firmware security, platform security, or low-level systems security.

Experience shipping or securing real hardware platforms, embedded devices, servers, accelerators, networking systems, BMCs, bootloaders, BIOS/UEFI, RTOS, kernels, or firmware update systems.

Deep familiarity with secure boot, measured boot, TPMs, hardware roots of trust, device attestation, key provisioning, debug interfaces, firmware signing, recovery, or lifecycle-state design.

Strong applied-cryptography judgment for secure boot, attestation, TLS/mTLS, key storage, certificate lifecycle, storage encryption, and long-range transitions such as post-quantum readiness.

Ability to read and write systems code in C, C++, or Rust and to use that skill to review, prototype, test, or debug security-critical behavior.

Comfort with hardware-software interfaces such as SPI, I2C, SMBus, PCIe, UART, JTAG, SWD, GPIOs, TPMs, and board-level debug tools.

Proven track record driving security improvements with hardware, firmware, infrastructure, manufacturing, operations, and partner teams.

Experience owning broad, ambiguous security programs end to end, including translating risk into technical requirements, validation plans, and accountable engineering decisions.

Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn ambiguous security risks into actionable requirements, design reviews, tests, and decisions.

To comply with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidates for this role may need to meet certain legal status requirements as provided in those laws and regulations.
